name: qf_tyres_v8
character: The Villain's wide tyres on a corner: a lower, broader stick-slip tone near 0.9 kHz and a heavier scrub, behind and beside the camera.
note: The tone is a pulse train at 900 Hz with harmonics through a tyre-cavity resonance, wobbling near 7 Hz with the slip, over a scrub of noise; its pitch and level follow the slide (stick-slip: a self-excited oscillation at the contact, lateral creep the trigger). ESTIMATE: the tone, its harmonics and the cavity formants are starting values (no source gave a tyre-squeal frequency); the squeal times are the drift and corner moments of the picture
